skills.Agentic AI & LLM-based Applications: Tool use and tool calling with failure recovery (LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK, ReAct agent loops; circuit breakers, fallbacks, deterministic guardrails), multi-provider LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude on AWS Bedrock, Google Gemini via LiteLLM, open-weight models via Ollama), LLM evaluation and testing (three-tier tests, hallucination-rate analysis), agent memory (persistent storage and retrieval across sessions), RAG pipelines (retrieval, generation, embeddings and the ChromaDB vector database), MCP servers (FastMCP, TypeScript SDK), prompt engineering, AI-assisted development (Claude Code as primary tool, Cursor, OpenAI Codex)
skills.Software Engineering & Integrations: TypeScript/Node.js, React, Python, JavaScript, FastAPI, Pydantic, RESTful APIs and third-party API integrations, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, SQL, MongoDB and DynamoDB (NoSQL), graph data (networkx), pytest, version control with Git (pull requests, code review), debugging and root-cause analysis, stakeholder communication, live client demos
skills.Cloud & Deployment: AWS (Bedrock, Lambda, ECR, S3, SQS, EC2, IAM, Cognito), Google OAuth sign-in, Docker, Kubernetes (AWS EKS), GitHub Actions CI/CD, serverless deployment

experience.title: Data Scientist, MSc Dissertation Project
experience.situation: Needed an LLM a research team could trust before it shipped
bullets: Built a generative AI assistant researchers could trust: it checks gene names against official databases and falls back to a local list of 19,213 genes if they go down (LangChain, AWS).
Did the data analysis on 14 research datasets and combined them so the assistant only used trusted data, then put it online on AWS (Python, AWS Lambda).
Found where the assistant went wrong with about 65 automated checks at three levels, fixed failures layer by layer, and reused the checks after changing AI provider (pytest).
Integrated the agent into a React front end with real-time gene alias enrichment.
Studied graph neural network research and designed how genes and cell lines are linked in one graph, with clustering to find similar ones (Leiden, KNN).

experience.title: AI Engineer

The client's founder later recommended me in writing, calling the server 'stable, production-ready' and saying it arrived ahead of schedule.
